cases.case_label: SVA_F in NMNAT1 intron 2 with partial SVA exonization (LCA)
cases.mechanism_detail: A complete 2,691-bp SVA_F (source on chr6) in NMNAT1 intron 2, in trans with other NMNAT1 variants, creates a new splice donor at position 875 of the SVA that competes with the canonical exon 2 donor; ~50% of SVA-allele reads show exon 2 elongated by 875 bp of intron/SVA sequence, introducing a premature stop (p.Tyr41Ser*57).
cases.quote: At the RNA level, an elongation of exon 2 and partial inclusion of the SVA_F element was revealed (875 bp).
